section_summary.extract_value: This section details a moderation analysis conducted to test if intelligence moderates the relationship between creative activities and creative achievement. A moderation model (A') was developed, incorporating a latent interaction term between intelligence and creative activities, which achieved a good fit. The analysis revealed a significant interaction (β=.28, p<.001), confirming that intelligence moderates the influence of creative activities on creative achievement, with the model explaining 67% of the variance in creative achievement. The methodology for constructing latent product terms using the residual-centring approach is also described.
